correctness.rationale: The fixed-parameter map is taken exactly from Xu–Chen Algorithm 1. On the gauge quotient its Sinkhorn derivative is the positive-plan weighted Gram matrix. Rank-nullity forces zero eigenmodes, and the two-state Jacobian gives an exact quadratic modal characteristic polynomial verified by hand and exact Fraction arithmetic. Strict Schur positivity proves local attraction. An affine disk-root criterion proves endpoint dominance for the whole spectrum, avoiding unsupported mode monotonicity. Lower bounds from root product and the zero-mode eigenvalue and strict quadratic arguments establish a unique minimizer in both parameter regimes. A 2x4 strictly positive family attains every admissible L; the standalone verification program passed 27,178 deterministic checks, including source-form finite differences.

value.rationale: The extra zero modes are forced by a common practical rectangular transport geometry, not an arbitrarily chosen slice. The source method has a natural fixed parameter that must control every dual state mode. On L=0.04 a 2x4 entropic transport example changes the sharp local factor from approximately 0.170761 under the earlier two-atom critical parameter to approximately 0.113238 under the derived rectangular optimum. The result rigorously selects a parameter across all positive plans of the stated dimensions, proves strict uniqueness, and supplies realizable sharp examples; no general downstream theorem is required for this independent optimization-landscape benchmark.
